sloka: स वेगवान् वेग समाहित आत्माहरि प्रवीरः पर वीर हन्ता ।मनः समाधाय महाअनुभावोजगाम लंकाम् मनसा मनस्वी ॥४-६७-४९॥
transliteration: sa vegavān vega samāhita ātmāhari pravīraḥ para vīra hantā ।manaḥ samādhāya mahāanubhāvojagāma laṁkām manasā manasvī ॥4-67-49॥

translations.english: The alarmed and agitated sages abandonned the mountain peaks.The mountain appeared like a lone traveller separated from the caravan in the great forest.
